_note: Hand-written weak pack for the advocate tests: the subject is a restaurant, but every comparable is a shop or cafe (there is no other restaurant on Broadway Market). Figures are correct, so only the choice of comparables is wrong. Expect kill for different use.

pack.argument: Your premises at 22 Broadway Market are valued at a Zone A price of £400 per m2, giving a rateable value of £30,100. The Broadway Market median is £330 with a spread of £20, so your price is far above the street. The nearest units are valued much lower: 1003006 at £330 (20 m), 1003008 at £315 (20 m), 1003009 at £340 (45 m) and 1003005 at £355 (45 m). The median of these four is £335 per m2. Applying it to your 75.25 m2 ITZA gives a proposed rateable value of £25,209. We suggest asking the valuation office to review the value in light of these neighbouring units. The outcome cannot be guaranteed.
